source_note: The report copy replaces only its unavailable temporary artifact directory with a placeholder; IDs, claims and suggested remedies are retained.
authority: Local repair, verification, commit, push and one follow-up PR; no merge/release authority for the follow-up PR.
excluded: New finding discovery and unrelated retention/lifecycle policy changes.

findings.summary: Ordinary command timeouts abort remaining repository work as execution_deadline.
findings.verification: Five baseline regressions failed: default cap, timeout taxonomy, supervision starvation, per-result scope deferral and per-event routing. Base-to-PR diff confirms introduction.
findings.qualification: Supervision happens before audit/publication/discovery, so its timeout can starve those stages. A routing timeout happens after those stages; it cannot retroactively skip them.
findings.fix: Distinguish shared deadline from a command cap. Defer incomplete per-attempt/result observations, isolate event errors, and retain the original uncapped behavior when neither a deadline nor an explicit timeout is supplied.

findings.summary: Process-group observation errors can discard successful child output or terminate the daemon.
findings.verification: Real local child plus injected ps nonzero/OSError/TimeoutExpired reproduces payload loss and daemon/startup failure; base/PR call reachability comparison confirms introduction.
findings.qualification: ps failures are injected; BusyBox itself was not tested. Unknown process-group state must retain ownership.
findings.fix: Use a daemon-local conservative observation adapter: failed group proof remains false, real child payload/timeout is preserved, and lease cleanup requires positive stop proof.

findings.summary: Generic analysis keywords override bug indicators in mixed ordinary bug reports.
findings.verification: All three supplied cases change from base bug_fix/new-pr to PR analysis/comment-analysis through the real issue producer and router.
findings.qualification: Explicit prefix requests, vote/review precedence, English word boundaries and negative fix requests remain supported.
findings.fix: Restore bug-first ordering only in the generic fallback after explicit request handling.

independent_review.scope: 4 production files and 2 new test modules; original three findings only

verification.nonreproduced_failure_note: One existing fast-worker test failed once during the first full suite. Twenty unchanged focused repetitions passed, and the final unchanged full-suite rerun passed. Notification type/root cause was not captured. No claim that this issue was fixed or proven pre-existing.
limits: ps faults injected; BusyBox itself was not tested
Source/test bytes matched the independently reviewed frozen snapshot throughout final checks
